title: Cardinal Roadside Assistance Service Menu by Option
content:
Service menu card for the Cardinal Roadside Assistance options: which on-site services each option includes and the limits that go with them.

Column key: **Basic** = Cardinal Roadside Basic; **Standard** = Cardinal Roadside Standard; **Plus** = Cardinal Roadside Plus; **Plus TI** = Cardinal Roadside Plus with Trip Interruption; **Premier** = Cardinal Roadside Premier; **Premier RV** = Cardinal Roadside Premier RV & Trailer.

## Services switched on by option

| Service | Basic | Standard | Plus | Plus TI | Premier | Premier RV |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Battery jump start | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| On-site battery testing and installation labor | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Lockout service | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Replacement keys or fobs paid | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| Flat tire change with the vehicle's spare | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Usable spare needed for the flat tire change | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No |
| Emergency fuel delivery | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Winch-out of a stuck vehicle back to the road | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Mechanical first aid (belts, hoses, fuses) | No | No | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Service at the member's home | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Limits by option

| Limit | Basic | Standard | Plus | Plus TI | Premier | Premier RV |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Most paid toward a locksmith or key cutting on a lockout | $0.00 | $50.00 | $75.00 | $100.00 | $100.00 | $150.00 |
| Most gallons of fuel delivered per call | 2 | 2 | 3 | 3 | 5 | 5 |
| Furthest distance from a public road for a winch-out | 0 feet | 50 feet | 100 feet | 100 feet | 100 feet | 100 feet |

## Notes on the menu

- **Locksmith limit of $0.00.** On Cardinal Roadside Basic the lockout service is door-opening service only; nothing is paid toward a locksmith or key cutting.
- **Battery labor.** Where battery testing and installation labor is included, the battery itself is the member's cost.
- **Fuel.** Fuel delivery covers bringing emergency fuel; the fuel itself is the member's cost.
- **Mechanical first aid.** Minor roadside adjustments to belts, hoses and fuses; parts are the member's cost.
- **Usable spare.** Where the menu shows "Yes" for a usable spare, the tire change needs one; without it the vehicle is towed as a tow call. Where it shows "No", a usable spare is not a condition of the service.
- **Winch-out distance of 0 feet.** Cardinal Roadside Basic does not include winch-out.

## Menu examples (hypothetical)

| Situation | Option | Result from the menu |
|---|---|---|
| Vehicle stuck 80 feet from a public road | Cardinal Roadside Standard | Beyond the 50 feet reached by a winch-out on this option |
| Vehicle stuck 80 feet from a public road | Cardinal Roadside Plus | Within the 100 feet reached by a winch-out |
| Out of fuel, 4 gallons wanted | Cardinal Roadside Plus | Up to 3 gallons delivered on the call |
| Flat tire, no usable spare | Cardinal Roadside Standard | Vehicle towed as a tow call |
| Fuse failure at the roadside | Cardinal Roadside Plus with Trip Interruption | Mechanical first aid is not included on this option |

The distances and quantities in the examples are illustrative inputs.
